I couldn't find a confirmed 2026 minimum adult IC card fare for Tokyo Metro. The results contain only partial figures, and most come from third-party travel blogs.

**Single-ride paper fares:** One guide lists Tokyo Metro adult single-ride fares of ¥180, ¥210, ¥260, ¥300, and ¥330, and says these include a ¥10 barrier-free fee. Tokyo Metro single-ride fares for adults come in denominations of those amounts. The ¥180 figure is the lowest on that list, but the source doesn't say whether IC card fares match it.

**Official Tokyo Metro page:** The only official result is a special-fare page for Ayase to Kita-senju on the Chiyoda Line. It lists an adult IC card fare of 146 yen and a regular ticket fare of 150 yen. From Saturday, March 14, 2026, barrier-free fees for train stations in this section will no longer be charged. This is a route-specific fare, not the network minimum, and it conflicts with the blog's claim that the ¥10 barrier-free fee is still included.

**Related 2026 changes:** JR East raised its fares on March 14, 2026 in its first system-wide revision since 1987. One source lists a JR East minimum IC fare of ¥157 and a paper-ticket minimum of ¥160. These are JR figures, not Tokyo Metro, and I couldn't verify them against JR's own release.

**Subway passes (for context):** The Tokyo Subway Ticket covers Metro and Toei lines. Following the price revision that took effect on March 14, 2026, the adult fares are ¥1,000 for 24 hours, ¥1,500 for 48 hours, and ¥2,000 for 72 hours. One source notes that you break even on the 24-hour pass at roughly four to five subway rides in a day.

For the exact current minimum IC fare, check Tokyo Metro's official fare pages at tokyometro.jp or the station fare charts, since the figures from secondary sources are inconsistent.

The minimum adult IC card fare on Tokyo Metro is **¥178**, versus ¥180 for a paper ticket. It has been at this level since the ¥10 barrier-free surcharge was added in March 2023, and nothing I found changes it for the main network as of October 2026 ([Nikkei/SBBIT, 2022](https://www.sbbit.jp/article/refers/86089); [train-shiori](https://train-shiori.com/tokyo-metrio-buy-ticket/)).

- **Not checked on the official site:** tokyometro.jp blocked automated access, so ¥178 comes from secondary sources. Toei Subway's official fare table lists the same ¥178 IC / ¥180 ticket for its shortest band ([Toei fare table](https://www.kotsu.metro.tokyo.jp/subway/fare/regular.html)).
- **2026 changes:** On March 14, 2026, only the Chiyoda Line's Ayase–Kita-senju special fare changed, going from ¥146 to ¥155 by IC. A system-wide fare revision is being considered for around March 2028 ([Tokyo Metro, Ayase–Kita-senju](https://www.tokyometro.jp/lang_en/ticket/particularcase/ayase_kitasenju/index.html); [pricey.jp](https://www.pricey.jp/web/articles/4455)).

Sources:
- [SBBIT: Tokyo Metro fare revision](https://www.sbbit.jp/article/refers/86089)
- [train-shiori: Tokyo Metro tickets](https://train-shiori.com/tokyo-metrio-buy-ticket/)
- [Toei Subway regular fares](https://www.kotsu.metro.tokyo.jp/subway/fare/regular.html)
- [Tokyo Metro: Ayase–Kita-senju special fare](https://www.tokyometro.jp/lang_en/ticket/particularcase/ayase_kitasenju/index.html)
- [pricey.jp: Tokyo Metro fare increase outlook](https://www.pricey.jp/web/articles/4455)
